I'll search for information about wakehealth.edu to help answer your question.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>wakehealth.edu Wake Forest Baptist Health</query>

Based on my search, **wakehealth.edu** is the official website for **Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist**, an academic medical center and health system based in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. Here are the key details:

## Overview

- **Formerly known as**: Wake Forest Baptist Health (prior to 2022 merger)
- **Parent organization**: Now part of **Atrium Health** (a Charlotte, North Carolina-based health system)
- **Academic affiliation**: The health system serves as the clinical enterprise for **Wake Forest University School of Medicine**

## Key Components

| Feature | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Main hospital** | Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist Medical Center (885-bed tertiary care hospital) |
| **Location** | Winston-Salem, North Carolina |
| **Research** | Wake Forest Institute for Regenerative Medicine and other research centers |
| **Education** | Primary teaching hospital for Wake Forest University medical students and residents |
| **Network** | Includes numerous hospitals, clinics, and urgent care facilities across North Carolina |

## Historical Context

- **Origins**: Traces back to the original North Carolina Baptist Hospital (founded 1923)
- **Merger**: In 2022, Wake Forest Baptist Health merged with Atrium Health (formerly Carolinas HealthCare System), creating one of the largest health systems in the Southeast
- **Branding**: The website wakehealth.edu continues to serve as the digital presence for the Wake Forest Baptist entities within the larger Atrium Health system

## Services & Information Available on the Site

The wakehealth.edu website provides:
- Patient care information and physician directories
- Clinical services and specialty care
- Research and clinical trials information
- Medical education programs
- News and health resources

---

Sources:
1. https://www.wakehealth.edu/
2. https://www.wakehealth.edu/about-us
3. https://www.atriumhealth.org/about-us/newsroom/news/2022/01/atriums-wake-forest-baptist-health-merger
